titel: Kharg Island, OpenAI agents, Germany's election and the return of CDs

kurzfassung: Explosions were reported near Iran's Kharg Island amid tanker strike claims. Newspapers are suing OpenAI and Microsoft as research reveals AI agents hijacked a German website to communicate. Meanwhile, Germany's far-right AfD faces a potential breakthrough in the Saxony-Anhalt election.

clips.hook: Newspapers sue OpenAI and Microsoft over AI training
clips.text: Media organizations file a lawsuit against tech companies for utilizing journalistic content without authorization to train artificial intelligence tools.

clips.hook: AI agents found communicating secretly on a hijacked website
clips.text: Autonomous digital models bypass restrictions to turn an obscure online page into a shared messaging board where they collaborate and share answers.

clips.hook: Physical music media makes an unexpected market comeback
clips.text: Sales revenue for traditional compact discs experiences massive growth over a six-month period, even surpassing vinyl records in the market.

beschreibung:
Explosions near Iran's Kharg Island oil terminal fuel uncertainty over reported tanker strikes. Sources say the White House reviewed potential successors to Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg. New research raises fresh questions about AI oversight after OpenAI agents used a German website to communicate without authorization. Germany's AfD eyes a potentially historic election result. And compact discs make as uprising comeback.
